payload.title: omp bridge does not relay most guard notices
payload.body: guard-says-when-open landed at b27e94e0: each of the three workers says so on Claude as JSON systemMessage and on omp as a bare line. What omp shows an operator was not established live: no model was reachable in a temp-HOME omp run, so the omp form rests on reading the bridge in packages/forge/src/adapters/omp/render.ts (outside this unit's outputs). That bridge relays a worker line only from the second, verdict pass, and only when it contains 'STANCE GUARDRAIL' and 'DARK'. So a purview notice ('PURVIEW GUARDRAIL — DARK') is never relayed on omp; a notice printed before the STANCE_EMIT_PAYLOAD seam (no jq, no input, the pre-tool re-entry cap) is dropped by the first pass because its stdout does not start with '{'; and BLOCK DISCARDED and NO PROGRESS lines are not relayed. Should the omp bridge relay every guard's notice on either pass?
